# A coding team that runs on your own computer.

Ask from your phone, desk or terminal. Mission Control hands the work to its agents, checks it, and brings back what's done.

Work comes back finished and checked, in the form you'd hand to a colleague.

## First, you ask.

One message, from wherever you are. No setup per task, no picking a model.

When one hits its limit, background work moves to the next one on your list.

## And it keeps going without you

### Every agent has its own Mochi

Each one has a job, a colour and its own memory.

Mission Control picks who fits, and you can build new ones.

### Approve from your phone

Hand off work on the train and merge it from the couch.

The app talks to your own computer, not a cloud copy of your code.

$ snippet ● mission control · 3 agents › bump the api to node 22 done handed to api agent done tests 212 / 212 done PR #214 opened

### Or straight from the terminal

The same team, in a full terminal app.

Sessions started here show up on your phone, and the other way round.

### It works while you're away

Put work on a schedule and read the results over coffee.

Quiet hours hold anything that isn't urgent until morning.

### It remembers the project

What it learns tonight, it still knows tomorrow.

Memory is plain files in your repo that you can read and edit.

Install it on your computer, then ask it to fix one small thing that's been bugging you.
